exposure: change in maternal height from childhood to pregnancy
change in maternal BMI from childhood to pregnancy
cohort: The study included 47,947 nulliparous women born from 1940 to 1996 who were part of the Copenhagen School Health Records Register.
finding: Maternal birth weight and childhood height were inversely associated with preterm delivery, while childhood BMI had a U-shaped association with very preterm delivery, and consistent short stature was associated with higher risks of both very and moderately preterm delivery.
gest_age: 22 to <37 weeks (categorized as 22 to <32 weeks for very preterm and 32 to <37 weeks for moderately preterm)
